project.description:
作文 — model compositions, the kind a primary-school pupil is asked to write and is shown before writing.
ITS OWN MODULE for the reason the others are: a group is the unit of authorship. These are written to a syllabus rather than to a subject — a PSLE composition has a shape, a length and a register that a fable or a map guide does not — and a series that follows one examination should be able to grow, or be retired, without 唐诗 moving.
It is also the group closest to what the reader is for. A child who must produce this kind of writing reads it differently from a story: for the turns of phrase, not only for the plot.
